g.text: Multi-server composition: two MCP servers behind one gateway
Phase 3.5 thickening (issue #17), ADR-006. Extends v1.0.0; proven at the live gate 2026-08-06, pending merge. NOT part of the v1.0.0 tag.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(242, 247, 253), rgb(22, 26, 31)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

g.text: shared app registration; per-server scope + role

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(238, 247, 238), rgb(22, 29, 22)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

g.text: API Management (Basic v2): one MCP gateway

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

g.text: Root PRM document (RFC 9728): describes the primary server.
Retained as the s3.3 fail-closed guard: a client that falls back here while
targeting another server sees a resource mismatch and MUST discard it.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(47, 91, 156), rgb(129, 167, 223));

g.text: - 401 challenge leads to ITS OWN metadata
(no-token rewritten by APIM to the server path;

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(47, 91, 156), rgb(129, 167, 223));

g.text: MCP server API: /catalog (2nd instance of the same module)
- 401 challenge leads to ITS OWN metadata
Easy Auth V2; Orders.Read app-role check (issue #45)

path.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(47, 91, 156), rgb(129, 167, 223)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(47, 91, 156), rgb(129, 167, 223));

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(253, 238, 238), rgb(39, 27, 27)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(184, 84, 80), rgb(215, 129, 126));

g.text: Per-server isolation: a token entitled to /orders only is ACCEPTED at /orders and
REJECTED at /catalog (403 insufficient_scope). Shared audience; isolation is per GRANT,
not per token. Audience-per-server is deferred to issue #42.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 249, 204), rgb(32, 27, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

g.text: Deliberately NOT here (issue #17): the REST-export server (#58/#18), per-tool authorization (#18),
content safety (#19), hostname-per-server and audience-per-server (#42). No backend change.
Challenge-rewrite behaviour is undocumented APIM; see COMPATIBILITY.md (re-verify each run).
